test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Settlers _________ a new colony in the early 18th century.
solution:
The correct answer is "**established**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Established** means **something that was built or founded**. 

 
 
• **Example:** *The migrants **established** an association in a foreign land. *
 
 
 
• Theref
